entries.summary: Promoted as the product candidate. 80/20 two-track regime split: trained on applications received before 2024, evaluated on 35,713 decisions in 2024-2025. ROC-AUC 0.792, average precision 0.409, Brier 0.090, log loss 0.313. GE10 (10+ units, n=464): ROC-AUC 0.782; riskiest decile refused at 63.8%, safest at 0%.

Specialised-scheme prior added as a disclosure: senior-living/care schemes historically refuse at ~27% (n=105, pre-2024) while the general score understates them; the app shows both figures. The prior does not replace the model score.

Comparable display metadata pack built (application references, dates, units, outcomes, inspector rationale) row-aligned with the frozen comparable reference. Display-only: the scoring path is unchanged.

Pre-Submission Review product shipped: evidence tabs, PDF report, portfolio with append-only score log, monitoring diffs, measured wording rewrites, risk register with unknowns and planner override audit trail.
